title: 新中国的梦
en: The Dream of a New China

sents.zh: 一百多年以前，中国还有王。
sents.en: A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor.

sents.zh: 很多人想，中国要不一样。
sents.en: Many people thought China should be different.
There was a man called Sun Yat-sen.

sents.zh: 他去过很多国家，看过很多事。
sents.en: He had been to many countries and seen many things.
He said the country belongs to everyone.

sents.zh: 他相信中国人可以做到。
sents.en: He believed the Chinese people could do it.

sents.zh: 很多年轻人跟着他做事。
sents.en: Many young people worked with him.

sents.zh: 一九一二年，新的国家开始了。

sents.en: The new government set up new schools.

sents.zh: 前面的路很难，可是大家还有希望。
sents.en: The road ahead was hard, but people still had hope.
